rendered: The V2O5 films tested electrochemically were the strained and unstrained films of ∼80 nm[1] and ∼40 nm[2] thickness (the thinner film is covered in the Supporting Information). The thicker film was grown with 1000 ALD cycles[3]. The thinner film came from fewer cycles, as the thickness-versus-cycle series in Fig. 1[4] shows. For the potential shifts, both films showed the same effect: potential shifts of ∼40 mV[5], and the paper states that similar shifts in values of ΔEeq(avg) were observed[6] for both thicknesses, owing to their similar locked-in elastic strains. So the potential shifts did not meaningfully differ between the thicker and thinner films.
